title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Cherry Berry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Cherry Berry blends juicy Cherry with a smooth medley of red berries for a rounded fruit profile with a gentle tart edge. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, this pack pairs a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers, keeping setup simple and spill free while removing the need for refilling or coil changes. The integrated mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt provide consistent MTL vapour and rapid nicotine satisfaction with strong, reliable flavour. How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
